auth-login-email.name: Login with email/password
auth-login-email.description: User signs in with email and password credentials

auth-login-invalid.name: Login with invalid credentials
auth-login-invalid.description: User sees error when submitting invalid credentials

auth-login-server-error.name: Login fails on server-side error
auth-login-server-error.description: Sign-in fails for a reason other than invalid credentials (disabled account, captcha rejection, 5xx, or network/timeout) and shows a generic failure notification

auth-register.name: Register new account
auth-register.description: User registers a new account via sign-up form

auth-google-login.name: Sign in or register with Google
auth-google-login.description: User authenticates via the Google button on sign-in/sign-up; backend creates or logs in the account. Structurally abstained: every e2e run sets window.__E2E_DISABLE_GOOGLE_LOGIN__=true so the Google button never renders (frontend/e2e/helpers/test.js:19-21); external-provider verification remains outside this E2E exemption; permissive backend tests do not establish authentication security.

auth-logout.name: Sign out
auth-logout.description: User signs out and session/localStorage is cleared

auth-protected-redirect.name: Protected route redirect
auth-protected-redirect.description: Unauthenticated user is redirected to sign_in when accessing protected routes

auth-guest-redirect.name: Guest route redirect
auth-guest-redirect.description: Authenticated user is redirected away from guest-only routes (sign_in, sign_up)

admin-login-handoff.name: Admin impersonation session handoff
admin-login-handoff.description: Vue app redeems the access/refresh tokens issued by the Django-admin 'Login as this user' action and lands the admin authenticated as the target user; missing/invalid tokens redirect to sign_in

shopping-catalog-browse.name: Browse product catalog
shopping-catalog-browse.description: User browses the product catalog page and sees products

shopping-product-detail.name: View product detail
shopping-product-detail.description: User navigates from the catalog to a product detail page, changes quantity and selects gallery images by touch, click or keyboard at 412x915, 835x1194, 1195x835, 1440x900 and 2560x1440

shopping-cart-add.name: Add product to cart
shopping-cart-add.description: User adds a product to the shopping cart from the detail page

shopping-cart-remove.name: Remove product from cart
shopping-cart-remove.description: User removes a product, or decrements its quantity, from the cart overlay or the checkout page

shopping-cart-persist.name: Cart persists across pages
shopping-cart-persist.description: Cart items persist when navigating between pages

shopping-checkout-complete.name: Complete checkout flow
shopping-checkout-complete.description: User creates an order with items in cart; creation failures preserve the cart and form with a visible error. The demo does not process card payments.

blog-list-view.name: View blog listing
blog-list-view.description: User views the blog listing page with blog entries

blog-detail-view.name: View blog detail
blog-detail-view.description: User navigates to and views a blog detail page

blog-detail-not-found.name: Blog detail handles non-existent entry
blog-detail-not-found.description: User navigates to a non-existent blog and the app handles it gracefully

home-carousel-navigate.name: Navigate home trending grids
home-carousel-navigate.description: At 835x1194, 412x915, 1195x835, 1440x900 and 2560x1440, the home page shows all received products and blogs in order in 2, 1, 5, 5 and 5 columns. The last card is reachable by normal page scrolling and opens its matching detail ID and title. No arrows, transforms or autoplay; component names and this flow ID are retained.

header-search.name: Search modal open/close
header-search.description: At 835x1194, 412x915, 1195x835, 1440x900 and 2560x1440, user opens search directly from the header through a target at least 44x44px, without opening the mobile menu, enters a real product title and follows its result to the matching detail. The existing close button closes search; header actions remain reachable without horizontal document overflow.

header-cart-overlay.name: Cart overlay open/close
header-cart-overlay.description: At 835x1194, 412x915, 1195x835, 1440x900 and 2560x1440, user adds a real product through catalog UI and opens the cart directly from the header through controls at least 44x44px. The panel and Checkout link are immediately available without decorative animation. Closing and reopening preserves title, quantity, subtotal and storage, and allows navigation to Checkout. The empty cart retains its message and catalog link. The backdrop closes the cart where it is exposed at widths at least 1024px; full-width compact and portrait panels use the close button.

theme-toggle.name: Switch color theme
theme-toggle.description: At 835x1194, 412x915, 1195x835, 1440x900 and 2560x1440, a single ThemeToggle is available directly in the header, without opening the mobile menu. Its trigger and options are at least 44px high; user selects Light/Dark/System and the preference persists after reload. Header controls remain within the viewport.

not-found-page.name: 404 not found page
not-found-page.description: User navigates to an unknown route and sees the 404 page

static-about.name: View About Us page
static-about.description: User views the About Us page content

static-contact.name: View Contact page
static-contact.description: User views the Contact page content

manual-view.name: View the operations manual
manual-view.description: User opens the public Manual page from the header nav and browses sections/process cards via the sidebar

manual-search.name: Search the manual
manual-search.description: User searches manual sections by keyword, navigates results with the keyboard, and jumps to a matching process card

backoffice-users-list.name: Backoffice: list users
backoffice-users-list.description: Staff user views the Users table on /backoffice; a non-staff authenticated user gets a permission error instead of data

backoffice-sales-list.name: Backoffice: list sales
backoffice-sales-list.description: Staff user views the Sales table on /backoffice; a non-staff authenticated user gets a permission error instead of data

staging-phase-banner-display.name: Staging review banner
staging-phase-banner-display.description: Sticky banner shown site-wide during an active (non-expired) staging review phase, with day-count and phase label

staging-review-expired-overlay.name: Staging review expired overlay
staging-review-expired-overlay.description: Full-site blocking overlay shown once the staging review window has expired, replacing all content with WhatsApp/email contact CTAs
